messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — final pre-event sync for DevHub meetup + webinar routing. Need confirmations today so I can finalize shipping and posts. TL;DR: booth staffing, swag counts, speaker submit status, webinar signup routing, benchmark post draft. Details below.

Ethan: On swag — courier pickup confirmed for Thu 9am. 300 stickers, 150 tees, 50 postcards. Tracking: UPS 1Z999... :package:

Priya: Webinar landing page is live: https://redwood.ai/devhub-webinar — I'm sending registrant webhook to our lead router. Can we route all booth QR scans as "event:devhub" and webinars as "channel:webinar"?

Liam: Yes. Routing rules (placeholder): 
```
event=devhub -> crm:leads?source=devhub_booth
event=webinar -> crm:leads?source=webinar_signup
```
Also need field mapping: name,email,company,interest_tag

Sam: Booth demo flow done — 2 stations (chat gen + embeddings search). Will bring spare HDMI, dongles, and 2 iPad stands. Need power strip count?

Maya: Power strips: 3. Also need two charge banks, battery for demo laptop. Staffing: shifts (9:30-12, 12-2:30, 2:30-5). Volunteers: Ethan, Sam, Maya, Priya, + 1 more (TBD).

Ethan: I can cover 9:30-12. Priya can do 12-2:30. Maya covering 2:30-5. I'll DM for the extra.

Priya: Speaker submission update — we got greenlight on proposal A (Priya + Sam panel) but waiting on venue confirm for 30-min slot. ETA by tomorrow noon.

Maya: Benchmark narrative: short post copy drafted in last comment. Focus on latency improvements and cost per 1k tokens vs baseline. @Sam can you add a screenshot of the 99th latency chart?

Sam: Yep attaching in next message. Also cleaned up the slide deck, exported PDF to Drive: https://drive.google.com/xxx

DeployBot: package-shipping status: label created for UPS 1Z999... scheduled pickup Thu 09:00.

Liam: Lead routing nitpick — QR code scans often drop company field. Add an optional company column and fallback tag "unknown_company". Also recommend capturing 'interest' via single-select on form.

Maya: Good call. Priya can you update the form? Also social launch: I'll post live thread on X at 8am PST day-of with 3 bullets + photo. Priya please schedule webinar reminder drip: 72, 24, 1 hour.

Priya: Done — drip scheduled. Also set UTM params: utm_source=devhub, utm_campaign=devhub_spring2026

Maya: Final ask — everyone confirm by EOD. If any blockers ping me. :thumbsup:
